description: This source file defines the 'Product' class within the Opencart Admin Controller Event namespace. It handles event-driven hooks for product-related operations such as add, edit, and delete, and adds corresponding tasks to a task management system.

classes.name: Product
classes.description: Controller class for handling product-related events in the admin panel.

methods.name: addProduct
methods.description: Adds a task to generate new product data after a product is added.

methods.name: editProduct
methods.description: Adds a task to regenerate product data after a product is edited.

methods.name: deleteProduct
methods.description: Adds a task to handle product deletion after a product is deleted.
